name: Marion
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 506 Marion: diameter 105.94 ± 2.6 km; JPL's stated reference: IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 105.94 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Marion. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: R. S. Dugan found Marion at Heidelberg on 17 February 1903.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 105.94 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
